title: cephalanthera alba
intro: Cephalanthera alba, commonly known as the white helleborine, is a type of terrestrial orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal disorders, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Cephalanthera alba include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, making it a potential treatment for respiratory issues and pain relief. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
